items.title: Howard Alden interviewed by Monk Rowe, Aspen, Colorado, October 11, 1997
items.q: I try to play some things that have a lot of single notes, like some Bach preludes or something like that

ctx.x: Yeah. What’s your practice — if you sit to practice, what do you practice these days?

Well I try to practice things that cover all the technical moves and I try to practice things that involve, again, musical contexts that I like. I try to play some things that have a lot of single notes, like some Bach preludes or something like that, and I try to practice some © Fillius Jazz Archive -12-
chordal things, I try to play some tunes, and explore some new tunes that I’m learning, and a little bit of stuff like that basically. Not enough of course.
